mentions.name: Chiù
mentions.description: Chiù is a small tray/menu-bar app for Windows and macOS that automatically prevents the computer from going to sleep while there is detectable network activity, such as a Steam game download or update. It lets users configure the activity threshold and grace period, and also offers a manual keep-awake mode. It currently ships without publisher certificates, so the OS may show a warning on first launch.
mentions.problem: Manually disabling automatic sleep in system settings whenever leaving a large download running is tedious.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a small tray/menu-bar app called Chiù that automatically prevents your computer from going to sleep while there's a detectable network activity, usually a download, e.g. a Steam game download/update.
mentions.author: Ma1kovich
